import os, datetime
# Ensure token
if 'token' not in globals():
    pw=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
    token=apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=token, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
year=datetime.datetime.now().year
spot_for={}  # file_path->spot
for f in files:
    info=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=token, file_path=f)
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(info.get('created_at'))
    if dt.year==year and dt.month==1:
        spot='Athens'
    elif dt.year==year and dt.month==4:
        spot='Seoul'
    else:
        spot='Paris'
    spot_for[f]=spot

# Move files
results=[]
for f in files:
    filename=os.path.basename(f)
    spot=spot_for[f]
    dest=f'{base_dir}{spot}/{filename}'
    try:
        r=apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=token, source_file_path=f, destination_file_path=dest, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
        results.append((os.path.basename(f), spot, 'ok', r.get('destination_file_path')))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((os.path.basename(f), spot, 'fail', str(e)))

print('moved_ok', sum(1 for x in results if x[2]=='ok'))
print('moved_fail', sum(1 for x in results if x[2]=='fail'))
print('sample_fails', [r for r in results if r[2]=='fail'][:5])
print('sample_ok', results[:5])
# Print count by spot
from collections import Counter
c=Counter(spot_for.values())
print('counts_by_spot', dict(c))
